verdict.rationale: Sai can be downloaded and run on your own Mac or Windows device (BYOD) instead of Simular-hosted cloud computers. Simular also publishes Agent-S, an open-source computer-use agent framework that can run in your own environments. However, the evidence never shows the commercial Sai service itself (API, orchestration, skills, approvals) being deployable on your own infrastructure, so BYOD looks like a local execution target tied to Simular's platform. Agent-S is a separate framework, not the full product. Missing for 10: documented self-hosted deployment of the Sai platform/API, evidence that BYOD runs independently of Simular's cloud, self-hosting install docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
